BEFORE  HON'BLE SHRI JUSTICE DINESH KUMAR PALIWAL  ON THE 18 th OF DECEMBER, 2023  MISC. CRIMINAL CASE No. 53930 of 2023  BETWEEN:-
 RAJKUMAR AHIRWAR S/O SHRI VIDESH AHIRWAR,
 AGED ABOUT 23 YEARS, OCCUPATION: STUDENT, R/O  VILLAGE PARRA P.S. RAJNAGAR, DISTRICT  CHHATARPUR (MADHYA PRADESH)
 
 (BY SHRI AMAN SONI - ADVOCATE)
 AND  1. THE STATE OF MADHYA PRADESH THROUGH  POLICE STATION RAJNAGAR, DISTRICT  CHHATARPUR (MADHYA PRADESH)

2 . VICTIM A  ..
 (STATE BY SMT. NUPUR DHAMIJA - PANEL LAWYER )

This application coming on for admission this day, the   following:
 ORDER

This second bail application under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure has been filed by the applicant for grant of regular bail relating to F I R No.178/2023 dated 21.06.2023, registered at P.S.- Rajnagar, District Chhatarpur (M.P.) for the offence punishable under Sections 363, 366-A,
376(2)(n), 354, 34 of IPC and Section 5(L)/6 and 7/8 of POCSO Act, 2012.
Applicant is in detention since 29.06.2023.

2. Applicant's first bail application was dismissed as withdrawn and not pressed with liberty to renew the prayer for bail after prosecutrix's evidence before the trial Court vide order dated 01.09.2023 passed in M.Cr.C. No.35942/2023.

sentences.text: A s p e r the prosecution story, on 21.06.2023, prosecutrix's father lodged an FIR about missing of his 17 years old daughter since 17.06.2023.
FIR was registered for commission of offence under Section 363 of IPC.
Prosecutrix was recovered on 27.06.2023.
After investigation, charge-sheet was filed for commission of the aforesaid offences.
4. Learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that applicant has not committed any offence.
He is innocent.
He has been falsely implicated.
It is further submitted that prosecutrix has already been examined before the trial Court.
She has not supported the prosecution story.
Therefore, it is prayed that applicant may be released on bail.
5. On the other hand, learned counsel for the respondent/State has opposed grant of bail to the applicant.
6. On a perusal of the evidence of prosecutrix recorded before the trial Court, it is apparent that she has not supported the prosecution story against the present applicant.

Therefore, having taken into consideration all the facts and circumstances of the case but without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, I am of the view that it is a case in which further pre trial detention of the applicant is not warranted.
Consequently, this bail application under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of bail filed on behalf of applicant, stands allowed.

7. It is directed that applicant - Rajkumar Ahirwar be released on bail subject to furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with one surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court, for his regular appearance before the trial Court during trial with a condition that he shall remain present before the concerned Court on all the dates fixed by it during trial.

He shall abide by all the conditions enumerated under Section 437(3) of Cr.P.C.
8.
This order shall be effective till the end of the trial.
However, in case o f bail jump and breach of any of the conditions of bail, it shall become ineffective.
Certified copy as per rules.

(DINESH KUMAR PALIWAL) JUDGE ak Rajkumar Ahirwar vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 18 December, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/2766095/
